label: Officer Moved an Object to See It (Not Plain View)
motion_heading: Moving the Object to Expose It Was a Separate Search Not Justified by Plain View

review_conditions.display_note: You aren't sure yet whether the officer moved or handled anything. This section was drafted anyway; review the body-cam footage before filing, or cut this section.

excluded_explanations.display_note: You aren't sure yet how police say they came across the evidence, so this issue wasn't drafted. If the reports claim plain view, check whether the officer moved, opened, or handled anything to see it.

rule_statements.text: Moving an object even a few inches to expose what was not already in view is a search, separate from whatever lawful activity brought the officer there.
Such a search requires probable cause; reasonable suspicion is not enough.
